jobs.title: RCM Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

**Job Description**

The Implementation Consultant II, RCM is a developing professional who plays a key role in helping customers successfully adopt and optimize revenue cycle management solutions. Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams, this individual supports system configuration, workflow design, issue resolution, and implementation activities while building expertise in healthcare operations and revenue cycle processes. The ideal candidate is curious, adaptable, and forward-thinking, with a passion for leveraging technology, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve customer outcomes, drive operational efficiency, and support successful product adoption.

**What You'll Do**

* Support customer onboarding and implementation activities, ensuring a smooth transition to Ensora solutions.
* Configure billing rules, payer setup, and claim workflows to align with customer requirements and best practices.
* Partner with customers to understand current-state workflows and recommend system configurations that support operational goals.
* Troubleshoot and resolve standard system and process issues, escalating more complex challenges when appropriate.
* Assist with the validation of claims and identification of rejections, denials, and processing errors.
* Document implementation activities, workflows, decisions, and system configurations.
* Communicate effectively with customers, project stakeholders, and internal teams to ensure alignment and progress throughout implementations.
* Monitor implementation milestones and support project deliverables to help ensure successful outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the customer experience.
* Utilize available technology, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, support data-driven decisions, and optimize implementation results.
* Stay current on industry trends, healthcare technology advancements, and revenue cycle best practices to support continuous improvement and innovation.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 2 or more years of experience.
* Experience with system implementation, revenue cycle management (RCM), or healthcare operations.
* Understanding of revenue cycle workflows and processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria.

The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

At **En****sora Health**, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community.

We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.

**Ensora Health** is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Onboarding Technician
jobs.description:
### **Client Onboarding Pharmacy Technician**

Remote Worker - N/A

**Great Career Opportunity in Long-Term Care Pharmacy!**

**Now Hiring: Pharmacy Tech - Onboarding**

**Location: Fully Remote, must be Texas licensed**

**Hours: M-F, 7:30a-4:00pCST**

**Description**

A Pharmacy Onboarding Technician performs a variety of administrative duties including prescription order entry, phone triage, billing, and insurance matters. The Onboarding Tech provides an extra layer of support for our new clients as they begin working with us. Experience with Framework and Docutrack software is required.

**Tarrytown Expocare Pharmacy** – We are a long-term care pharmacy that provides specialized care for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities throughout the United States. We originated as part of an independent retail pharmacy, Tarrytown Pharmacy, which has been serving the local community since 1941. Through our dedication to provide excellence to our customers, we have grown from a small independent pharmacy to a multi-state long-term care pharmacy solution. If you are hardworking, dedicated and looking for a change in your career, we may have an opportunity for you!

**We are proud to offer:**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive healthcare benefits
* 401(k) retirement plan with company matching
* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* A closed-door pharmacy work environment
* Opportunities to advance and grow your career
* **And More!**

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Accurately and efficiently enter new orders and refill orders
* Properly handle order exceptions such as refill-too-soon, invalid orders, etc.
* Handle inbound and outbound calls with other facilities
* Identify orders that are valid and those that are invalid, and carry out appropriate order entry and workflow
* Adjudicate insurance claims and resolve rejections
* Initiate and follow through on refill requests with prescribers
* Triage and troubleshoot requests from prescribers and customers
* Proactively identify challenges and resulting solutions quickly and follow through on plan of action
* Communicate with prescribers, caregivers, leadership, and peers to work effectively together to meet deadlines
* Achieve or exceed productivity standards in a fast-paced environment
* Stay adherent to Onboarding deadlines and follow through on designated tasks
* Package Tracking via Fedex and Courier Services
* Become familiar with common EMAR programs (Therap, QuickMAR) and coordinate pharmacy transfers
* Perform Facility Training to various audiences to educate on pharmacy processes and online portal

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Minimum one year experience in a retail or long-term care pharmacy; 3+ years preferred
* Must possess a **Texas State Board of Pharmacy Technician License**
* **Experience with FrameworkLTC and DocuTrack software required**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with prescribers, medical staff, caregivers, leadership and peers via telephone and email
* Ability to meet deadlines and function well in a high-paced and at times stressful environment
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
* Understands basic pharmacy language needed to interpret prescriptions
* Perform basic pharmacy calculations
* Is available for occasional overtime

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to withstand long hours of computer screen time
* Repetitive motion deskwork

*Tarrytown is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Commercial Excellence Training Specialist - Remote, US  
  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  
  

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  
  

**About the role:**

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Excellence Training Specialist to design, deliver and continuously evolve ICON’s commercial training and capability programs. This role is intentionally broad in scope: rather than owning a single fixed curriculum, the successful candidate will build and flex a portfolio of enablement initiatives – spanning bid defense excellence, onboarding, continuous coaching and capability development – in line with ICON’s changing commercial priorities.

  
  

The role establishes a consistent, high-performing approach to commercial capability building, equipping Business Development, Operations, Therapeutic Experts and senior stakeholders to perform at their best across client-facing moments that matter. Working closely with Business Development, Clinical Operations, Proposals, Therapeutic Experts, Learning & Development and senior leadership, the role owner will maintain best-practice methodologies, training content and performance improvement frameworks, and will be expected to take on new initiatives as ICON’s commercial enablement agenda develops.

  
  

***Key Responsibilities*** *:*

* Develop, implement and maintain standardised, end-to-end methodologies for priority commercial capability programmes, starting with bid defence excellence and expanding to other initiatives as agreed with leadership.

* Establish frameworks for strategy, preparation, delivery and post-activity evaluation that can be adapted across multiple training initiatives, not limited to a single programme.

* Develop and maintain playbooks, training resources, preparation tools, presentation guidelines and templates that can be reused and re-purposed across initiatives.

* Partner with commercial and operational leaders to keep methodologies aligned with client expectations, organisational capabilities and evolving business priorities.

* Drive adoption of best practice across business units, therapeutic areas and regions.
  

  

**Your Profile:**

***Essential***

* Significant experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Enablement, Learning & Development, Business Development or a related function.

* Experience designing and delivering training for cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

* Experience implementing standardized methodologies, competency frameworks and improvement initiatives.

* Strong understanding of the clinical research industry and CRO business development lifecycle, including proposals and bid defenses.

* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple concurrent initiatives and adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

* Excellent facilitation, presentation, coaching, communication and stakeholder-influence skills.

* Strong project management and analytical skills; experience in a global or matrixed organization.
  

  

***Desirable***

* Previous experience in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or clinical research organization.

* Direct experience supporting or participating in client bid defenses.

* Knowledge of clinical trial operations, study delivery and therapeutic strategy.

* Experience establishing commercial training programs, centers of excellence, or enablement platforms.

* Experience with AI-enabled coaching tools, digital/interactive learning design, or sales enablement technology (e.g. Seismic or similar).

* Relevant qualification in Learning & Development, instructional design, organizational development or business.
  

  

#LI-MH1

#LI-REMOTE

  
  
  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  
  

**Rewards & Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  
  

Benefits may include:

* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  
  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  
  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  
  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

jobs.title: Implementation Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**Implementation Specialist**

**Who We Are**

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

**The Role**

The Implementation Specialist is responsible for all communications, documentation, setup, installation, and billing activation during the onboarding process for new customers. The Implementation Specialist works closely with internal teams and customers to provide accurate product configurations and installations, schedule all trainings, and communicate onboarding information to ensure a successful product launch. This position is remote based and requires excellent organizational skills, successful time management and good communication skills.

**What You’ll Do**

* Complete simple to moderately complex tasks related to customer installations of products.
* Consultatively work with assigned clients to determine setup requirements, configure the product per the customer’s specifications and complete installation. Ensure products are updated accurately and product integration processes are deployed within expected timelines.
* Provide client support via phone and email throughout the installation process.
* Interact with internal teams to initiate and maintain successful implementations and share necessary improvements and desired changes that surface from customers.
* Coordinate training dates with customers and Implementation Trainers
* Work with Implementation Trainers during training for any additional setup items or support issues that may arise.
* Maintain the internal documentation of installation tasks, details, and client communication within Salesforce throughout the installation period.
* Work independently under general supervision with minimal directions
* Possess decision making capabilities to self-prioritize workload to optimize time and ensure contract billing is timely and accurate.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Prior automotive and/or implementation experience are a plus.
* Some Microsoft Office and SalesForce skills preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and ability to effectively interact with both internal and external customers.
* Must possess strong organizational skills to effectively multi-task, prioritize responsibilities, and proactively follow-up on tasks.
* Successful in working in a fast-paced environment. Adapts easy to change. Analytical with the ability to learn new products and solutions quickly.
* Self-motivated. Highly effective when working independently with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem solving and decision-making skills, with ability to follow through independently and multi-task.
* Highly developed sense of integrity and commitment to customer satisfaction, with a drive for excellence and willingness to adapt.

*It is impossible to list every requirement for, or responsibility of, any position. Similarly, we cannot identify all the skills a position may require since job responsibilities and the Company’s needs may change over time. Therefore, the above job description is not comprehensive or exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to adjust, add to or eliminate any aspect of the above description. The Company also retains the right to require all employees to undertake additional or different job responsibilities when necessary to meet business needs.*

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**  
*The Solera group is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.*

Focusing on launch project coordination, back-office system configuration, client user management, software training, and advising on best practices for deployment and adoption, this Implementation Consultant I role will work with new clients to configure and launch Navigate360 solutions. This role owns the client experience through the onboarding phase of the customer lifecycle through the delivery of admin user and system launch.

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Manage multiple concurrent customer launch projects, ensuring each remains aligned with defined timelines and milestones.
* Coordinate and manage the onboarding configuration and technology integration timeline with customer.
* Monitor customer progress and provide regular, actionable check-ins to keep customers accountable to key launch deliverables and due dates.
* Conduct effective and engaging training across multiple formats (live to many, virtual live to many, recorded, individual, and needs-based sessions).
* Maintain a deep level of understanding and be able to effectively communicate the various Navigate360 SaaS solutions’ values and functionalities.
* Understand education terminology and the needs/requirements of school administrations and law requirements for school safety management.
* Exercise independent discretion to drive customer participation in setting up and training aspects of launch.
* Create/design training webinar content.
* Effectively adhere to implementation timeline with the customer.
* Execute detailed configuration procedures and confirm functional.
* Confirm customer expectations are being met for product and staff training rollout.
* Report customer “pulse” evaluation (include in health metrics).
* Maintain clear customer records for launch progress within the designated tool.
* Maintain competitive understanding of Navigate360’s primary competitors.
* Ensure a timely response to customer requests.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associates or Bachelors Degree; or equivalent years of experience
* Passion for ensuring the physical safety of students, faculty, and staff
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written (email) communications skills
* Dynamic communication presence
* Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive projects and priorities and meet established deadlines.
* Experience documenting processes and creating customer-facing reference materials.
* Experience leveraging a CRM Platform (Salesforce, Salesforce Lightening, Zoho…etc.)
* Highly competent in PC/Mac operating systems and Microsoft Office365 Applications

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 1-2 years of Education-Tech SaaS configuration and support experience
* 1-2 years of customer software training over the phone
* Experience in Emergency Management, Behavioral Threat Assessment, or Secondary Education
* Experience with Student Information System integrations (Clever, ClassLink, PowerSchool)
* Bilingual English/Spanish

**Normal Working Hours and Conditions:** Core business hours are generally 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. However, this position will require work to be performed outside of normal business hours based on Company operations.

**Physical Requirements:** Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in an office setting including verbally communicating, seeing, and hearing to exchange information and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard. Daily physical functions include standing, sitting, and walking for prolonged periods of time and occasionally stooping, bending, kneeling, crouching, reaching, and twisting. The employee may engage in lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling light to moderate amounts of weight up to 25 pounds. The position also requires the operation of office equipment requiring repetitive hand movement.

jobs.title: Specialist, Clinical Implementations (Clinical Licensure Required) - REMOTE
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides support for the deployment and integration of Molina enterprise clinical implementations, programs, technologies, and workflows. Ensures alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational goals. Represents as a liaison between clinical, technical, and administrative teams; focuses on planning and executing implementations that fit existing workflows while supporting patient care and operational efficiency.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Supports planning and execution of clinical system implementations.
* Develops and executes implementation plans, timelines, and milestones.
* Ensures compliance with clinical standards, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, new workflows, and technology.
* Assists during implementation phases to ensure smooth adoption of new workflows and technologies.
* Serves as a resource for clinical teams, addressing questions and resolving issues promptly.
* Delivers post-implementation support to maintain system functionality and optimize performance.
* Provides ongoing support and troubleshooting during and after implementation. Partners with clinicians, administrators, and information technology (IT) teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions.
* Represents as a liaison between clinical teams and technical teams to translate requirements and feedback.
* Monitors implementation progress and identify areas for improvement.
* Collects and analyzes data to measure program effectiveness.
* Recommends enhancements to optimize workflows and system performance.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 3 years of direct clinical, health care technology implementation, or clinical program management experience, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Registered Nurse (RN) or Advanced Practice Social Worker (APSW), or Licensed Behavioral Health Clinician (MSW, LCSW). Clinical licensure and/or certification required ONLY if required by state contract, regulation, business operating model, or state board licensing mandates. If licensed, license must be active and unrestricted in state of practice.
* Proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and health care IT systems.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and provide practical solutions.
* Familiarity with data analysis tools and reporting software.
* Competence in project management tools.
* Ability to collect, interpret, and analyze data to measure program effectiveness.
* Skilled in identifying process gaps and recommending workflow optimizations.
* Critical thinking skills, and ability to resolve implementation challenges quickly.
* Ability to facilitate training and generate stakeholder engagement.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience managing timelines, deliverables, and priorities in fast-paced environments.
* Ability to adapt to changing requirements and maintain focus on goals.
* Detail-oriented, and committed to accuracy and quality.
* Self-motivated, and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
* Comfortable in high-pressure situations and capable of meeting deadlines.
* Strong collaboration skills, and ability to work effectively with clinical, technical, and administrative teams.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Microsoft Office suite and applicable software program(s) proficiency.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Case Manager (CCM), Certified Professional in Healthcare Management (CPHM), Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), or other health care or management certification.
* Familiarity with change management principles and process improvement methodologies.
* Experience creating executive summaries and decks; comfortable presenting to varying stakeholders and audiences, including executive leadership.
* Change management experience.
* Medicaid/Medicare/Duals population experience.
* Six Sigma green belt or higher certification.

  

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.  
  
Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V.

jobs.title: Health IT Analyst - Medicaid Data Exchange (SQL / EHR / CCD-ADT)
jobs.description:
**Health IT Analyst (HMS Analyst) | Remote, North Carolina residents preferred | State Government Contract through October 2027**

**Job Type:** Contract (W2 only, no 1099, no Corp-to-Corp)

**Pay:** $68.44 per hour

**Location:** Remote; preference for candidates living in North Carolina

**About the Opportunity**

Changing Technologies, Inc. (CTI) is hiring an HMS Analyst for the North Carolina Health Information Exchange Authority (NC HIEA), part of the NC Department of Information Technology (NCDIT). You will support the HIE Medicaid Services (HMS) program, a partnership between NC HIEA and NC Medicaid (NCDHHS Division of Health Benefits) that improves Medicaid quality and population health through better data exchange: moving to digital quality measures (dQMs), improving health-related social needs (HRSN) data exchange, and improving care management data sharing. You will work with guidance on simple to medium complexity efforts.

**What You Will Do**

* Support the rollout, expansion, and daily operations of Medicaid data exchange services within NC HIEA
* Improve HRSN data capture and onboard early adopters
* Turn program and partner needs into clear technical and workflow requirements
* Support Continuity of Care Document (CCD) and Admission-Discharge-Transfer (ADT) data integration
* Coordinate work across teams to improve data quality and interoperability
* Troubleshoot issues with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Guide testing and onboarding so new data connections are accurate, secure, and aligned with statewide population health priorities
* Use SQL, relational databases, and BI dashboards for healthcare reporting and analysis
* Explain technical topics clearly to technical and non-technical partners

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in healthcare IT and EHR operations, supporting healthcare systems, analytics, technical support, and EHR workflows
* 3+ years with advanced SQL, relational databases, BI dashboards, and healthcare reporting
* 3+ years in business analysis: requirements documentation, process analysis, troubleshooting, and solution design
* 3+ years with healthcare data standards and compliance, including ICD-10, CPT, LOINC, and HIPAA
* 3+ years in stakeholder communication: translating technical concepts, managing priorities, and working with teams and vendors
* Strong familiarity with health information exchange standards

**Work Location and Schedule**

* Remote; preference for candidates living in North Carolina
* Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
* Start date: October 26, 2026; contract through October 25, 2027
* Interview: webcam only

**Work Authorization**

* Must be authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the assignment
* CTI participates in E-Verify; employment eligibility for all hires is verified in compliance with applicable state and federal requirements
* This is a W2 engagement only. We do not work with 1099 or Corp-to-Corp (C2C) arrangements, and third-party or agency submissions will not be considered

**Why This Role**

* Improve how Medicaid data moves across North Carolina's health information exchange
* Remote role with a state agency
* Full one-year contract

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume through Indeed. This requirement has an immediate submission deadline, so apply today. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly.

Changing Technologies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Pay: $68.44 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Application Question(s):

* This is a W2 only role. We do not do Corp-to-Corp or 1099. Do you accept this requirement?
* This role is remote, and North Carolina residents are preferred. Do you currently live in North Carolina?
* This role requires 3+ years with healthcare data standards such as ICD-10, CPT, LOINC, and HIPAA. Do you meet this requirement?

Experience:

* Healthcare IT / EHR operations: 5 years (Required)
* SQL and healthcare reporting: 3 years (Required)
* Business analysis / requirements gathering: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
